item.title: Court Terms Shirtless Protest at AI Summit Symbolic “Political Critique,” Grants Bail to Youth Congress Members
item.description: GUWAHATI: A Delhi court has granted bail to nine members of the Indian Youth Congress who were arrested over a shirtless demonstration during the India AI Impact Summit at Bharat Mandapam. The court ruled that the protest amounted to symbolic political expression and warned that continued detention before trial could amount to unjust punishment.
